title: SCAP-NG 0.4 capability-specific native Object selectors
description: Generated capability-specific selector overlay. Resolved entries close the operator vocabulary and value constraints; unresolved mappings are intentionally not guessed.

selector_value_reference.description: Variable or Input reference used as a selector value.

linux_dpkginfo_name_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 dpkginfo_object.name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; Debian package version/EVR state comparison remains separate from package-name selection.

linux_partition_mount_point_selector.description: The native contract uses the string selector vocabulary. Source-specific conversion must retain the selected operation and does not infer a broader typed comparison.

linux_selinuxboolean_name_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 selinuxboolean_object.name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; current and pending Boolean state values are not selector aliases.

linux_systemdunitdependency_unit_selecto.description: OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitdependency_object.unit is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; dependency state is not an additional selector.

linux_systemdunitproperty_unit_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitproperty_object.unit and property are EntityObjectStringType selectors. Preserve all five source string operations; the collected property value remains a state field.

linux_systemdunitproperty_property_selec.description: OVAL 5.12.3 systemdunitproperty_object.unit and property are EntityObjectStringType selectors. Preserve all five source string operations; the collected property value remains a state field.

unix_file_filepath_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.

unix_file_path_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.

unix_file_filename_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 unix file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Existing traversal constraints stay in the capability mapping.

unix_interface_name_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 interface_object.name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; interface type/address state fields are not selector aliases.

unix_password_username_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 password_object.username is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations and the authored spelling; account lookup and collected-field comparison remain separate.

unix_shadow_username_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 shadow_object.username is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations and the authored spelling; account lookup and collected-field comparison remain separate.

windows_file_filepath_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 Windows file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Filesystem lookup remains per-directory/provider case context from the existing mapping; no global case switch is added.

windows_file_path_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 Windows file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Filesystem lookup remains per-directory/provider case context from the existing mapping; no global case switch is added.

windows_file_filename_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 Windows file_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations through the native crosswalk. filename null is the explicit directory-object form; empty string remains a string operand. Filesystem lookup remains per-directory/provider case context from the existing mapping; no global case switch is added.

windows_fileeffectiverights_filepath_sel.description: OVAL 5.12.3 fileeffectiverights53_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations, including the source-limited non-equals trustee SID search. filename null selects the higher-level directory. SID identity and effective-rights acquisition remain separate from native string comparison.

windows_fileeffectiverights_path_selecto.description: OVAL 5.12.3 fileeffectiverights53_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations, including the source-limited non-equals trustee SID search. filename null selects the higher-level directory. SID identity and effective-rights acquisition remain separate from native string comparison.

windows_fileeffectiverights_filename_sel.description: OVAL 5.12.3 fileeffectiverights53_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations, including the source-limited non-equals trustee SID search. filename null selects the higher-level directory. SID identity and effective-rights acquisition remain separate from native string comparison.

windows_fileeffectiverights_trustee_sid_.description: OVAL 5.12.3 fileeffectiverights53_object selectors use EntityObjectStringType and retain all five string operations, including the source-limited non-equals trustee SID search. filename null selects the higher-level directory. SID identity and effective-rights acquisition remain separate from native string comparison.

windows_ntuser_key_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 ntuser_object key and name use EntityObjectStringType with all five string operations. name null selects the higher-level key and empty string remains the default-value name. Existing hive/profile discovery and traversal controls remain separate.

windows_ntuser_name_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 ntuser_object key and name use EntityObjectStringType with all five string operations. name null selects the higher-level key and empty string remains the default-value name. Existing hive/profile discovery and traversal controls remain separate.

windows_registry_hive_selector.description: Hive names are canonical enum values. Case-insensitive source equality is normalized to the canonical enum equality operation; a generic case switch is not exposed.

windows_registry_key_selector.description: Registry key identity is case-insensitive. The explicit operation remains part of the authored contract so source conversion and native evaluation can preserve intent.

windows_registry_name_selector.description: Registry value-name identity is case-insensitive. The explicit operation remains part of the authored contract so source conversion and native evaluation can preserve intent.

windows_regkeyeffectiverights_hive_selec.description: OVAL 5.12.3 regkeyeffectiverights53_object uses the canonical registry-hive enum with equals only; key and trustee_sid retain all five EntityObjectStringType operations. key null selects the higher-level hive. Source-limited non-equals trustee searches and security-descriptor errors remain conversion/runtime concerns.

windows_regkeyeffectiverights_key_select.description: OVAL 5.12.3 regkeyeffectiverights53_object uses the canonical registry-hive enum with equals only; key and trustee_sid retain all five EntityObjectStringType operations. key null selects the higher-level hive. Source-limited non-equals trustee searches and security-descriptor errors remain conversion/runtime concerns.

windows_regkeyeffectiverights_trustee_si.description: OVAL 5.12.3 regkeyeffectiverights53_object uses the canonical registry-hive enum with equals only; key and trustee_sid retain all five EntityObjectStringType operations. key null selects the higher-level hive. Source-limited non-equals trustee searches and security-descriptor errors remain conversion/runtime concerns.

windows_service_service_name_selector.description: OVAL 5.12.3 service_object.service_name is an EntityObjectStringType. Preserve all five source string operations; SCM service-name identity and display-name fields remain separate, and the documented Windows SCM case behavior is not a global selector switch.
